Priya: Rooftop picnic this Friday 12:00? Sunny forecast. Quick yay/nay and what you'll bring (main + one snack). Also any dietary restrictions? :sun_with_face:
LunchBot: Poll created — options: ✅ I'm in, ❌ Can't make it, Maybe — vote here <https://polls.redwood/picnic-1752312345>
Jon: I'm in. Bringing grilled veggies + chips. Vegan here. :v:
Maya: Count me in! Bringing sandwiches (I can make a few veggie ones). Also can handle plates/napkins.
Sam: Maybe — team call might run over. If I can make it, I'll bring drinks (seltzer).
Lena: In! I'll bring tacos from El Buen :taco: (can do vegetarian). Also I can bring a blanket.
Carmen: Can't make it Friday — PTO. Sad. Pass on dishes but will bring a deck of cards for game night next week? :cry:
Priya: Thanks! Rain plan: conference room 3B. @Jon can you help with folding tables?
Jon: Yup I can. I'll pick up folding tables from storage.
Maya: Does anyone have a portable speaker?
Sam: I have one, can bring if I'm there.
Lena: Also we should avoid bringing nuts — someone on last week's demo was allergic. Maybe annotate in the poll.
Priya: Good call. LunchBot: Added 'nut-free' note to the event.
Priya: Awesome — final check Thursday 3pm. If you want to add what you're bringing edit the poll or reply here. :party_popper:
Maya: I'll add extra veggie sandwiches.
Jon: I'll bring a small propane grill and tongs.
Lena: I'll confirm taco count Thu.
Sam: If I'm not there, I'll Venmo for drinks.
Carmen: Enjoy y'all! :heart:
